notes:
Summary: Sequoia Armory is a national defense OEM evaluating Redwood Private for operator assistance and incident response in SCIFs and isolated garages. Very conservative security: air-gapped enclaves, FIPS 140-2 HSM, DISA STIG expectations, no external telemetry permitted. Primary asks: 1) a reproducible airgap POC plan that runs fully offline (control plane can be customer-managed), 2) documented STIG hardening steps for Redwood images, 3) HSM/KMS integration guide + attestation, 4) fallback model strategy when capacity constrained (local 7B quantized).

What they said: "We cannot accept any opaque callouts — every binary and kernel module needs provenance and hardening steps." — CISO.

Constraints / non-negotiables: network egress blocked; must support removable media-only image updates; operator consoles in SCIF w/ no external access; hardware roster pre-approved (NVIDIA A100-LC and Habana Gaudi discussed).

PoC scope requested: single SCIF rack deployment, ~200 concurrent operator sessions (chat), p95 latency target <=150ms for short-turn assistant flows, batch reranking jobs run on isolated schedule. Cost sensitivity: high for recurring hosted spend, willing to fund capital/ops for private deployment.

Commercial: looking at 12–36 month dedicated/private contract; procurement requires Tech Eval Board sign-off and stamped IL4 equivalent classification.

AE notes: keep POC limited to essential items; provide STIG gap matrix by 2025-12-10; coordinate with security compliance team for attestations.
requirements_summary: Workload: operator chat + document search + policy evaluation. Throughput: 200 concurrent chat sessions (interactive), reranking batch windows at night. Latency: p50 < 60ms, p95 <= 150ms (short prompts). Models: prefer open weights (quantized 8-bit/4-bit), ability to pin versions and run model variants locally. Observability: token-level telemetry retained on-prem only; no outbound telemetry. Ops: offline image update process, hardware whitelist, FIPS/HSM keywrap. Rollout: start with single SCIF rack POC -> expand to 3 sites. Acceptance criteria: STIG checklist satisfied, HSM integration validated, performance within latency SLOs, no external network egress during POC.
